idea-plugin.name: Novel Library Reader
idea-plugin.description:
Novel Library Reader connects to the desktop application or starts the bundled local Runtime so you can browse a private local library without modifying project files or writing book content into source code.

Core features

  • Browse books, chapters, and the current reading window in a dedicated tool window.
  • Display text in paragraph or compact end-of-line modes inside the editor.
  • Continue across chapter boundaries with mouse-wheel and keyboard navigation.
  • Show the chapter number, title, and overall progress while you read.
  • Synchronize reading position through the localhost desktop Bridge or local Runtime.

Usage: connect to the running Novel Library desktop app, or select local mode and import TXT or EPUB files directly. Communication remains on localhost.

Compatibility: IntelliJ IDEA and compatible IntelliJ Platform IDEs based on version 2024.1 or newer.
